mapper.insert: INSERT INTO count_adjustment_intent(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,plan_id,line_id,observation_id,operation_id,actor_id,context_json,context_hash,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.e},#{row.w},#{row.plan},#{row.line},#{row.observation},#{row.operation},#{row.actor},CAST(#{row.context} AS JSON),#{row.hash},'PENDING',#{row.now},#{row.now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,plan_id,line_id,observation_id,operation_id,actor_id,context_json,context_hash,state FROM count_adjustment_intent WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND line_id=#{line} FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.id FROM count_line l WHERE l.enterprise_id=#{e} AND l.warehouse_id=#{w} AND l.count_plan_id=#{plan} AND l.status IN ('OBSERVED','RESERVATION_CONFLICT') AND l.counted_qty IS NOT NULL AND l.recovery_attempts<8 AND (l.recovery_next_at IS NULL OR l.recovery_next_at<=#{now}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM count_observation o WHERE o.enterprise_id=l.enterprise_id AND o.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND o.count_line_id=l.id AND o.observation_kind='SERIAL') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM count_adjustment_intent a WHERE a.enterprise_id=l.enterprise_id AND a.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND a.line_id=l.id) ORDER BY l.recovery_next_at,l.id LIMIT 20

SELECT id,serial_id,sku_id,operation_id,kind,from_epoch,state,result_json FROM count_serial_intent WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND adjustment_id=#{adjustment} ORDER BY serial_id LIMIT 401
mapper.update: UPDATE count_adjustment_intent a SET state='READY',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE a.enterprise_id=#{e} AND a.warehouse_id=#{w} AND a.plan_id=#{plan} AND a.state='PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM count_serial_intent s WHERE s.enterprise_id=a.enterprise_id AND s.warehouse_id=a.warehouse_id AND s.adjustment_id=a.id AND s.state<>'DONE') ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 20
UPDATE count_adjustment_intent SET state='APPLIED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND line_id=#{line} AND state='READY'

UPDATE count_serial_intent SET state='RUNNING',claim_epoch=claim_epoch+1,attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=#{until},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND attempts<12

UPDATE count_serial_intent SET state=#{state},result_json=CAST(#{result,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON),last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{next},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND state IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT id,plan_id,adjustment_id,serial_id,sku_id,operation_id,kind,from_epoch,state,claim_epoch,attempts FROM count_serial_intent WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE count_line SET recovery_next_at=#{next},recovery_error_code=#{error}, recovery_attempts=CASE WHEN #{waiting} THEN recovery_attempts ELSE LEAST(recovery_attempts+1,8) END WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{line} AND status IN ('OBSERVED','RESERVATION_CONFLICT')
